narration:0:1810734001:0.text: As Tephesia channels her magic, the lift's security seal is lifted.
narration:0:1810734001:0.source_cn: 随着苔佩希注入魔力，升降梯的验证解除了

narration:1:1810734002:0.text: At the same time, the commotion grows louder and louder.
narration:1:1810734002:0.source_cn: 与此同时，楼下的声音也越来越嘈杂

narration:2:1810734003:0.text: Without wasting a moment, the two of you descend deeper into the mysterious underground office...
narration:2:1810734003:0.source_cn: 你们抓紧时间，深入了地下那间神秘的办公室……
